proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL haḍḍa explicitly gives Punjabi/Hindi haḍḍī, Gujarati/Marathi hāḍ and, in the addendum, Kotgarhi hàṛkɔ, Jaunsari hāḍkī and Garhwali hāḍgu with a hāḍku comparison. The selected simple and k-extended bone forms fit this documented family; vowels, voicing, retroflexion, optional h, nasalization and inflection remain as elicited. The medial k extension is directly attested, not reconstructed from the survey alone. Turner calls the connection with asthi/aṣṭhi very doubtful; no such deeper ancestry is asserted. Regional IA transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: haḍko.
